standard.summary: 加噪后把张量范数缩回加噪前，抑制 long-run 范数漂移
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Scales the tensor norm back to what it was before the noise was added, suppressing long-run norm drift
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 加噪后把张量范数缩回加噪前，抑制 long-run 范数漂移（尤其 relative）。

advanced_en.principle: After adding noise, rescales the tensor norm back to its pre-noise value, suppressing long-run norm drift (especially with relative mode).
